messages:
marie: Hey team — opened a cleanup PR for the auth module split, mostly moving helpers and renaming exports. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123 Can someone take a quick look for style/exports? Hoping to merge in tonight's 20:00 UTC window. Main things: modularize auth/*, remove barrel files, update import paths. No logic changes but a few lints. @aj if you have time :eyes:

aj: I can grab it in ~2h. Quick question — CI is red atm, is that expected? CI: https://ci.internal/1234

sahil: fyi we've seen flaky tests in auth on main lately, if CI shows unit timeout ignore and rerun. Also watch for build size change.

deploy-bot: AUTODEPLOY scheduled for 2027-03-10 20:00 UTC if PR merged before 19:45 UTC

marie: CI failed on eslint: "no-unused-vars" in auth/utils/formatter.ts. Small diff to fix: 
```
- const fmt = (s: string) => s.trim()
+ export const fmt = (s: string) => s.trim()
```
I can push fix but would prefer smaller change from reviewer.

aj: pushed tiny eslint fix and updated import paths in one commit, running CI now — will approve once green :thumbsup:

sam: skimmed — one nit: prefer named export for parseToken for readability. Not blocking.

marie: thanks! @aj please approve+merge when CI passes. I'll monitor canary post-merge. :pray:

aj: will do. merging window ok. (reaction :rocket:)
